title: 第1041 新剑界四第1040章 新剑界三
content_zh:
那只手落下的时候，小飞扬头顶那一顶不起眼的牛角战盔忽然涌现出一股强大波动。
那是一顶布满了刮痕，像是从哪个古战场上随手捡回来的破烂，在早早融合青帝宝石之后，已然变成一件强大至极的防御器物。
它一直戴在小飞扬头上，即使陈越等人也不知道这顶战盔的来历。
但就在楚东流五指触及盔顶的瞬间，它爆出了一团刺目欲盲的强大光芒，一股让人窒息的压倒性力量汹涌而出。
“轰——！！！”
楚东流整个人像是被人从正面搡了一把，五指尚未抓实便猛地弹开，整个人踉跄飞出十数丈之外。
他的掌心传来一阵灼痛，低头看去，方才被无上剑经划出的那道淡痕边缘竟然冒出了丝丝缕缕的青烟。
“这是什么东西？！”
他抬头，目光死死锁定小飞扬头顶那顶牛角战盔。此刻那头盔上的光芒正在迅速膨胀，从小飞扬的头顶向四周扩散，凝聚出一道半透明的巨大人形轮廓——数十丈高，肩宽臂长，通体银白，面目的线条模糊而粗犷，像是一尊用月光浇铸而成的远古神将之影。
巨神之影微微俯身，将小飞扬整个人护在了自己的双臂之间，如同一座移动的堡垒。那双银白色的空洞眼窝“盯”着楚东流，没有喜怒，只有一种石头般的沉寂。
楚东流面色一沉。他没有犹豫，右手再次抬起，这一次掌中凝聚了整整七成修为，化作一道凝如实质的神道光柱，轰然砸向那尊巨神之影的胸口。
“咚——！”
沉闷的响声传遍废墟，脚下的碎石被震得跳了起来。巨神之影的双臂交叠在胸前，硬生生扛住了这一击，整个身影向后滑了半尺，银白色表面泛起一阵涟漪状的波纹，但迅速恢复了平整。
楚东流的眉梢挑了一下，几乎七成神道修为，居然没能打穿。
他没有停。第二击、第三击、第四击——一掌接一掌，每一掌都比前一掌更重。神道的光柱如暴雨倾盆，连绵不断地砸在巨神之影身上，终于那尊银白神影开始出现细密的裂纹，从手臂蔓延到肩头，再从肩头扩散至胸腹，像是被重锤反复敲打的冰面，裂纹越来越密、越来越深。
远处，东侧和西侧的两道裂口处，两名缥缈神宗的通天境不断出手。
其中一人是个枯瘦老者，双目半闭，随手一挥袖，袖中飞出一面黑色小旗，旗面迎风暴涨，化作一道漆黑如墨的屏障横亘在山壁前方。另一人是个身材高大的壮汉，手持一柄重锏，目光冰冷地扫视着那些试图冲过来的剑修，只消锏身一横，便有一股无形大力将数名剑修震得当场横死。
“都给老子趴着！”壮汉的声音如洪钟炸响，震得山壁上碎石簌簌落下，“不听我缥缈神宗号令，便让你们这群剑修今日尽作白骨！”
剑修们红了眼，有人嘶吼着撞向那道黑色旗幕，剑光撞在上面发出刺耳的摩擦声，却只能在旗面上留下一道浅浅的白痕。更多人被重锏的余波扫中，吐血跌落。但他们仍在往前扑，一个倒下了，后面的踩着同伴的身体继续冲。有人连剑都断了，赤手空拳地扑向那道黑色屏障，指骨在旗面上撞得血肉模糊。
而那尊巨神之影身上的裂纹，片刻已经蔓延到了腹部。

“咔嚓——”
一声清脆的破裂声。巨神之影左臂从肘部开始碎裂，银白色的碎片如雪花般散落，在半空中便化为光点消散。
楚东流又是一掌拍出，这次巨神之影整个胸腹部位塌陷了一大块，光芒急剧黯淡。它踉跄着后退，双膝微屈，依然死死地将小飞扬圈在自己的怀抱里，不肯松手。
楚东流的脸上终于浮现出一丝狰狞的笑意。
他高高抬起右掌，掌心中凝聚出一团比之前任何一击都要浓郁的神道光球，光球内部雷光闪烁、道法之力膨胀到一个难以理解的地步，隐隐产生扭曲的规则符文，显然已是全力出手。
“护得住一时，护不住一世，这破烂东西，还有你和你这座剑界，都一同去死吧！”
他一掌按下。
神道的光球带着毁灭一切的气息向着巨神之影头顶压去。光球过处，空间被压缩成一道恐怖的深渊隧道，周围剑土之上的一切纷纷化为齑粉。
巨神之影仰头望着那道光球，空洞的眼窝中闪过一丝微不可察的波动，双臂抬起，做出了最后格挡的姿态。
然而所有人都知道，这一击挡不住。它的裂纹已经布满了全身，如同即将碎裂的瓷器。
小飞扬蜷缩在巨神之影的怀抱中，意识模糊间感应到了那即将降临的毁灭之力。他拼命想动，想站起来，可却连一根手指都抬不起来，神魂枯竭到仿佛耗尽了最后一丝力气。
然而，就在那神道光球距离巨神之影头顶不足三尺的那一刻——
所有剑修腰间、手中、背后的剑，同时发出了一声清越的颤鸣。
那种鸣响与之前的任何一次都不同。它不是恐惧，不是哀鸣，而是一种兴奋，一种近乎朝圣般的震颤。
不仅是他们所在的这片剑土，哪怕是那些尚在荒废的剑土之上断剑、锈剑、甚至只是剑柄的残骸，都在同一瞬间朝着同一个方向微微倾斜，剑尖遥指——洪荒剑壁的方向！！
一道银光自那面剑壁的深处飞出，快得超出了所有人所能捕捉的极限，只有那尖锐到极致的破空声撕裂了空间，在剑土上空拉出一道长逾百丈的银白色尾迹。
银光穿过两名通天镜之间的空隙，穿过了那道黑色旗幕的缝隙，在巨神之影即将破碎的前一刹那，最后精确无比地悬停在了楚东流的眉心前方三寸处！！！
content_en:
When that hand fell, a powerful wave suddenly appeared from the inconspicuous horn helmet on Xiao Feiyang's head.
It was a helmet covered with scratches, as if it were a rag picked up from an ancient battlefield. After being fused with the Blue Emperor Gem early, it had become an extremely powerful defensive weapon.
It has been worn on Xiao Feiyang's head. Even Chen Yue and others don't know the origin of this helmet.
But the moment Chu Dongliu's five fingers touched the top of the helmet, it burst out with a blinding and powerful light, and a suffocating and overwhelming power surged out.
"Boom——!!!"
Chu Dongliu's whole figure seemed to have been pushed from the front. Before his fingers could grasp it, he suddenly bounced away, and his whole body staggered and flew more than ten feet away.
There was a burning pain in his palm, and when he looked down, there were wisps of green smoke coming out of the edge of the faint mark made by the Supreme Sword Sutra.
"What is this?!"
He raised his head and fixed his gaze on the horned helmet above Xiao Feiyang's head. At this moment, the light on the helmet was rapidly expanding, spreading out from the small flying head to the surroundings, condensing into a translucent giant humanoid outline - dozens of feet tall, with broad shoulders and long arms, all silvery white, with blurred and rough lines on the face, like the shadow of an ancient god-general cast by moonlight.
The shadow of the giant god leaned forward slightly, protecting Xiao Feiyang's entire body between his arms, like a moving fortress. Those silver-white empty eye sockets "stared" at Chu Dongliu, with no emotion or anger, only a stone-like silence.
Chu Dongliu's expression darkened. He did not hesitate, and raised his right hand again. This time, a full 70% of his cultivation was condensed in his palm, turning into a pillar of Shinto light that was as solid as a substance, and slammed into the chest of the shadow of the giant god.
"Boom——!"
A dull sound spread throughout the ruins, and the gravel beneath his feet was shaken to the point of jumping. The Shadow of the Titan crossed its arms in front of its chest and withstood the blow. The whole figure slid back half a foot. There was a ripple-like ripple on the silver-white surface, but it quickly returned to smoothness.
Chu Dongliu raised his eyebrows. He was almost 70% divinely cultivated, but he couldn't penetrate it.
He didn't stop. A second blow, a third blow, a fourth blow - one after another, each one heavier than the one before. The Shinto light beams poured down like a torrential rain, continuously hitting the shadow of the giant god. Finally, fine cracks began to appear on the silver-white god's shadow, spreading from the arms to the shoulders, and then from the shoulders to the chest and abdomen. It was like an ice surface that had been repeatedly struck by a heavy hammer. The cracks became denser and deeper.
In the distance, at the two cracks on the east and west sides, two Tongtian Realm members from the Piao Miao Shen Sect kept taking action.
One of them was a skinny old man with half-closed eyes. He waved his sleeve casually, and a small black flag flew out of his sleeve. The flag swelled in the wind and turned into a pitch-black barrier in front of the mountain wall. The other man was a tall, strong man, holding a heavy mace. He glanced coldly at the sword cultivators who were trying to rush over. With just one move of his mace, there was an invisible force that shook several sword cultivators to death on the spot.
"Get down here!" The strong man's voice sounded like a bell, causing gravel to fall from the mountain wall. "If you don't listen to the orders of my Piao Miao Divine Sect, you sword cultivators will turn into white bones today!"
The sword cultivators' eyes turned red. Someone screamed and crashed into the black flag screen. The sword light hit it and made a harsh friction sound, but it could only leave a shallow white mark on the flag surface. More people were swept away by the aftermath of the heavy weapon, vomiting blood and falling. But they were still rushing forward. One fell down, and the others stepped on the bodies of their companions and continued to charge. Some people even broke their swords and threw themselves at the black barrier with bare hands, their finger bones smashing against the flag until they were bloody.
And the cracks on the shadow of the giant god had spread to the abdomen in a moment.
"Click——"
A crisp cracking sound. The left arm of the Shadow of the Titan began to shatter from the elbow, and the silver-white fragments scattered like snowflakes in the air.The stool turned into a point of light and dissipated.
Chu Dongliu struck out with another palm. This time, the entire chest and abdomen of the Shadow of the Titan collapsed, and its light dimmed sharply. It staggered back, its knees slightly bent, and still tightly held Xiao Feiyang in its arms, refusing to let go.
A ferocious smile finally appeared on Chu Dongliu's face.
He raised his right palm high, and a ball of Shinto light that was stronger than any previous strike was condensed in his palm. The inside of the light ball flashed with lightning, and the power of Taoism expanded to an incomprehensible level, and twisted rule runes were faintly produced. It was obvious that he had shot with all his strength.
"I can protect you for a while, but I can't protect you for a lifetime. This rag, as well as you and your sword world, let's die together!"
He pressed down with his palm.
The light ball of Shinto pressed towards the head of the shadow of the giant god with the aura of destroying everything. Wherever the ball of light passed, the space was compressed into a terrifying abyss tunnel, and everything above the surrounding sword earth turned into powder.
The shadow of the giant god looked up at the ball of light, an imperceptible fluctuation flashed through its empty eye sockets, and raised its arms in a final blocking gesture.
However, everyone knew that this blow could not be blocked. It has cracks all over its body, like porcelain that is about to break.
Xiao Feiyang curled up in the arms of the shadow of the giant god, and vaguely sensed the coming power of destruction. He tried desperately to move and stand up, but he couldn't even lift a finger. His soul was so exhausted that it seemed as if he had exhausted all his last strength.
However, at the moment when the Shinto light ball was less than three feet away from the head of the shadow of the giant god——
The swords on the waists, hands, and backs of all the sword cultivators simultaneously let out a clear trembling sound.
The ringing was unlike any before. It is not fear, not a whine, but an excitement, an almost pilgrim-like tremor.
Not only the sword soil where they were, but also the broken swords, rusty swords, and even the remains of the sword hilts on the abandoned sword soil, all tilted slightly in the same direction at the same moment, with the sword tip pointing far away - in the direction of the prehistoric sword wall! !
A ray of silver light flew out from the depths of the sword wall, faster than anyone could capture. Only the extremely sharp sound of breaking through the air tore through the space, leaving a silver-white trail over the sword soil that was more than a hundred feet long.
The silver light passed through the gap between the two sky-reaching mirrors, passed through the gap in the black flag curtain, and at the moment before the shadow of the giant god was about to shatter, it finally hovered three inches in front of Chu Dongliu's eyebrows with incomparable accuracy! ! !
